# Intro

Calculate AUC for differentially expressed candidate markers.

# Settings

```{r}
input_file <- "data/processed/deseq_input_ptsd.rds" # from ptsd_input.qmd
markers_file <- "results/blood_markers/marker_table.csv" # from blood_markers.qmd

target_level <- "Current"
ref_level <- "Never"

# Same rule as deseq2-analysis.qmd
min_count <- 10 # prefilter -> reads a sample needs for a gene to count as expressed in it
min_frac <- 0.5 # prefilter -> keep genes expressed in >= this fraction of samples in either group

out_dir <- "results/marker_auc"
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
```

# AUC function

AUC from ranks (Mann-Whitney). Ties count half.

```{r}
auc <- function(score, y) {
  r <- rank(score)
  n1 <- sum(y)
  n0 <- sum(!y)
  (sum(r[y]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}
```

# Import data

```{r}
inp <- readRDS(input_file)
step3 <- read.csv(markers_file)
markers <- step3$symbol[step3$label == "Changes with PTSD"]
markers

keep_samples <- inp$coldata$ptsd %in% c(target_level, ref_level)
coldata <- inp$coldata[keep_samples, ]
counts <- inp$counts[, coldata$SAMPID]
genes <- inp$genes

y <- coldata$ptsd == target_level # TRUE = current PTSD
table(y)
```

# Expression

Variance-stabilised expression, the score each marker's AUC is computed on.

```{r}
expressed <- rowSums(counts >= min_count) >= min_frac * min(table(y))
vst_all <- vst(counts[expressed, ], blind = TRUE)
rownames(vst_all) <- genes$Description[match(rownames(vst_all), genes$Name)]
dim(vst_all)
```

# Single-marker AUC

Below 0.5 means lower in current PTSD; `auc_either` flips those so 0.5-1 reads they're consistent.

```{r}
single <- data.frame(marker = markers, auc = sapply(markers, function(g) auc(vst_all[g, ], y)))
single$auc_either <- pmax(single$auc, 1 - single$auc)
```

# Slide table

Step 3 results plus the AUC, sorted by AUC.

```{r}
st <- step3[match(single$marker, step3$symbol), ]
slide_tab <- data.frame(Gene = st$symbol,
  `In PTSD` = ifelse(st$log2FoldChange > 0, "up", "down"),
  `log2 FC` = sprintf("%.2f", st$log2FoldChange),
  padj = sprintf("%.3f", st$padj),
  `In plasma` = ifelse(st$measured_in_blood == "both", "both", "MS"),
  AUC = sprintf("%.2f", single$auc_either), check.names = FALSE)
slide_tab <- slide_tab[order(-single$auc_either), ]
slide_tab
```

# Save

```{r}
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(single, file.path(out_dir, "single_marker_auc.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
